title: FIFO write
text: Write simple data streams, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Input vector type} sets input data type 8 bit uint null; {Size}, {Data present output} sets the enables output DP, {Sample time} and {ID} sets the identifier for overflow messages character. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: D
ports.summary: Data to write to FIFO vector

ports.name: DP
ports.summary: True if new data is present in the FIFO true | false

params.name: Size
params.values: Size of FIFO, in bytes 1024 (default) | integer

params.name: Input vector type
params.values: Specify input data type 8 bit uint null terminated (default) | count+32 bit int | count+32 bit uint | count+16 bit int | count+16 bit uint | 8 bit int null terminated

params.name: ID
params.values: Identifier for overflow messages character vector
